findings.title: Entry sign-flip construction duplicated in refund.py and ledger.py

evidence.quote:
def reverse(entry: Entry) -> Entry:
    return Entry(account=entry.account, amount_cents=-entry.amount_cents, reason="reversal")

findings.note: Both files build a new Entry by negating amount_cents on an existing account/id; the two files are already change-coupled (shared=5, ratio=0.714) per history, so the sign convention has to be kept consistent by hand in two places.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: record dict built from Entry fields for JSON persistence looks similar to refund.audit_trail's string formatting, but they serialize to different targets (disk log vs audit string) for different reasons to change; not the same duplication.

not_assessed: No clone-detector tool report was available; assessment relies on manual reading of the 5 non-test src files only.
